decisions.reason: The same message already establishes the dashboard's decision-support purpose and required metrics. The source Event's investment-story and investor-attractiveness updates do not necessarily add a distinct dashboard attribute.
The decision to emphasize an investment story and investor attractiveness does not change the requirements for source-data review, formula checking, or credible figures.

The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY covering simplification and auditability. The source Event's narrative emphasis and investor-attractiveness requirement are separate and require no further candidate update.
Message 36 does not change assumption annotation or the reference basis; easier review and a stronger investment narrative do not necessarily alter traceability requirements.

The source decision changes how the overall investment case is communicated, not the availability-payment sizing method or required viability and bankability demonstration. Investor attractiveness is not explicitly assigned as a new availability-payment criterion.
The narrative and investor-attractiveness changes do not alter the capex estimate, site-capex basis, provisional status, or treatment of shared costs.
The source decision does not change the confirmed debt-equity split, debt cost, mezzanine treatment, or single-tranche financing structure.
The communication-focused source modification does not change the operating-cost range, assumption basis, or excluded Appendix basis.
The investment-story and investor-attractiveness requirements do not change the authoritative Business Case site list.
